review_scope: static source review only; no solver, tests, assembly, numerical integration, render, or Git

findings.description: The JSON normalizer correctly converts nested NumPy generic scalars including np.bool_, but maps any nonfinite Python float to null. Post-solve residuals, energy/work, relative errors, and off-grid reductions do not all have explicit finite guards before the result retains a SOLVED status. A nonfinite diagnostic can therefore be silently written as null in a successful-looking receipt.
findings.required_resolution: The output-only v2 revision should explicitly reject nonfinite diagnostic scalars as UNKNOWN before serialization; do not promote null metrics as a solved receipt.

findings.description: V1 publishes a stiffness hash rather than raw K and omits f, c, canonical coefficient IDs, and pointwise off-grid coordinates/reference/solution values. The result cannot be independently audited or visualized without reassembly.
findings.required_resolution: Review the requested distinct v2 output-only snapshots and their pins before any execution.

findings.description: The side net force and Lagrange multiplier are reported separately, but no explicit translation-compatibility residual ties the load-vector translation projection to the integrated force and saddle reaction. V2 raw f and c snapshots can make this relation independently inspectable; no additional threshold was presumed.
